title: CreateProject v1
description: The canonical KinetixUI Create document. One versioned value carries the design-system, page and Figma-synchronisation workflows; the three are views and transforms of it, never separate documents. This file is the ONLY structural source: scripts/create-schema/validate.mjs interprets it rather than re-expressing it, so there is nothing for a second derivation to disagree with. Rules a structural schema cannot express (a reference resolving against a live manifest, node-id retirement, provenance pointing at a node that exists) are the semantic layer of that same validator and are listed in docs/create/README.md.

schemaVersion.description: Bumped by a migration, never inferred from the shape of the document. Present from the first commit: retrofitting it after projects exist costs a heuristic that guesses.

domain.description: The business domain the project serves. Namespaced: a bare "commerce" is a validation error, because `commerce` is both a business domain and a block category. See docs/create/IDENTIFIER-NAMESPACES.md.

retiredNodeIds.description: Node ids that have been deleted. They are never reused: a reused id makes a re-sync update the wrong Figma frame and makes a provenance record attribute a human's node to a model.

figmaBinding.description: null until the project has been synced once.

provenance.description: Per node, not per project: a project-level "made with AI" flag answers neither the attribution split nor the claim that a generation produced this exact valid document.

nodeId.description: Generated once and monotonic within a project; the numeric suffix is what makes monotonicity checkable.

designSystem.description: The preset string IS the design-system core: @kinetixui/create-preset already encodes brand, neutral, radius, surface and chart palette into a versioned KX1_ code with its own validator and canonicaliser, and resolveCreateTheme is deterministic across processes. Re-expressing those choices as loose JSON would create a second derivation that has to agree with the first by hand. `overrides` carries only what the codec cannot express.

node.description: Three kinds in v1. `layout` is deliberately absent: the repository has no canonical layout registry, so a `layout:` reference could not be resolved by any gate, and an unresolvable identifier space is what the namespace decision exists to prevent. See docs/create/README.md, open decisions.

slotNode.description: A named hole. It has no ref: a slot refers to nothing, it is where something goes.

propValue.description: Scalars and shallow arrays of scalars. Rendered output, code and markup are never stored: they are derivable, and storing one creates a second source of truth with a staleness problem.

nodeIds.description: Our page id to its Figma node id: the sync key.

lastSyncedDigest.description: A digest of what WE last wrote, so a conflict is detectable rather than overwritten.
